value.rationale: This natural finite-rate network-reset baseline provides a structural collapse of the entire path and stationary fluctuation law from n intrinsic frequencies to one scalar after a pinned graph-Poisson translation, beyond a stationary mean computation. It exposes a sharp zero-total-drive degeneracy and supplies a closed finite-rate phase-difference variance on the smallest nontrivial network. These are useful exact benchmarks for studying stochastic pinning and testing the limits of fast-reset/grounded-Laplacian approximations; no claim of a general nonlinear theorem is made.
